description: Evaluate whether an email address is suitable for a specified use case using syntax, MX, SPF, DMARC, disposable-domain, and role-account signals. Returns a deterministic ALLOW, REVIEW, or REJECT decision with deliverability score, risk level, confidence, checks, and reasons. Does not send email, probe the mailbox via SMTP, verify that the mailbox exists or is owned by a specific person, or guarantee delivery. **USE WHEN:** an agent needs to decide whether an email address is suitable for outbound sales, account signup, transactional email, CRM import, lead qualification, or another supported use case. **DO NOT USE WHEN:** the agent needs domain-level risk and trust assessment or proof that a mailbox exists. **USE `domain_risk_trust_decision` FOR:** domain-level risk and trust assessment. Parameter semantics: `email` is the address to evaluate; `use_case` provides the usage context that may affect the decision.

use_case.description: Intended sending context; when provided, the decision accounts for context-specific risk.
use_case.title: Use Case

name: email_suitability_decision

confidence.description: Confidence in the decision from 0 to 100.

decision.description: Context-aware suitability decision for the given use case.

mx_found.description: Backward-compatible MX result; null means lookup unavailable.

risk_level.description: Risk level derived from observed signals.

valid.description: Backward-compatible validity summary based on deliverability score >= 60. Does not prove mailbox existence or delivery.

title: Email Suitability Decision
